emailDelivery.title: Email delivery
emailDelivery.description: Monitor queued messages, provider acceptance, retries and development previews.
emailDelivery.deliveryNotice: Sent means accepted by the SMTP provider, not confirmed inbox delivery. Previewed messages are local development files and were not emailed. Security links and message bodies are never shown here.
emailDelivery.empty: No email messages match these filters

errors.RECIPIENT_OR_POLICY: Recipient or provider policy rejected the message
errors.PAYLOAD_OR_CONFIGURATION: Message payload or configuration requires attention
errors.NO_LONGER_ELIGIBLE: Recipient, preference or security link is no longer eligible
